name: search_events
description: Search calendar events by date, title, attendee, or description.

name: read_event
description: Read details for a known calendar event using an event ID.

name: update_event
description: Update an existing calendar event such as changing its time.

name: create_event
description: Create a new calendar event.

name: delete_event
description: Delete an existing calendar event.

name: invite_attendee
description: Invite an attendee to a known calendar event.

description: Check calendar availability for a date and time.

name: list_events
description: List calendar events for a date.

name: find_event_by_attendee
description: Find calendar events with a specific attendee.

name: summarize_event
description: Summarize details of a known event.

name: search_emails

description: Search emails and return only matching message IDs.

description: Read the full email conversation thread for a known message ID.

description: Summarize the content of an email body.

name: extract_email_deadline
description: Extract a deadline from an email body.

name: create_draft
description: Create an email draft. Does not send the email.

description: Send an email immediately to a recipient.

description: Forward a known email to another recipient.

description: Archive an email message.

name: delete_email
description: Delete an email message.

name: label_email
description: Apply a label to a known email message.

name: list_email_labels
description: List available email labels.

name: search_contacts
description: Search contacts by person name.

name: search_files
description: Search user files by title, topic, recency, or file type.

name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a known file using a file ID.

name: summarize_section
description: Summarize a specific section of a document.

name: summarize_document
description: Summarize an entire document.

name: extract_section
description: Extract a named section from a document.

name: rename_file
description: Rename a known file.

name: share_file
description: Share a known file with another person.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a known file.

name: create_doc
description: Create a new document.

name: find_latest_file
description: Find the latest file matching a topic.

name: search_web
description: Search the public web for information.

name: open_url
description: Open a URL and return page text.

name: summarize_page
description: Summarize webpage text.

name: calculate

name: convert_currency
description: Convert one currency amount to another.

name: lookup_stock
description: Look up a stock price.

name: compute_mortgage
description: Calculate estimated mortgage payment.

name: run_tests

name: patch_file
description: Patch a code file.

name: run_linter
